meta.title: TI 2026 Swiss Predictions
meta.subtitle: Open-source group-stage forecast
meta.disclaimer: Доска Swiss: Monte Carlo на pairwise blend (XGB+CatBoost) с team Elo/Glicko-2 ±uncertainty + player/chemistry. Home LAN (+Δ Elo CN/Shanghai) — meta для main event, в μ Group Stage не добавляется. Слоты компендиума — points-optimal под таблицу Valve. Это исследовательский прогноз с высокой неопределённостью — не для ставок и не финансовый совет.
meta.format: 16-team Swiss to 4, 5 rounds Bo3 + ER (5 of 10)
meta.fusion_weight_note: tune_fusion_weight_loo is an in-sample grid on current predictions (not true LOO CV).
meta.methodology: Leave-One-TI-Out; sample half-life 210d; form ~40d; patch≥7.41 sample mult 1.25; tier weights ti=2/major=1.5/qual=0.75/online=0.5; Empirical Bayes Elo shrink + Glicko-2 (μ/RD/σ); roster Jaccard stitch ≥0.6. Calibration: XGB final fit may use isotonic; production blend bundle is uncalibrated — isotonic on LOO is metrics-only.
meta.calibration_policy: XGB pipeline: optional isotonic on final fit. Blend production joblib: no isotonic. Isotonic on pooled LOO blend = offline eval only.
meta.swiss_bye_policy: Odd leftover in a Swiss record bucket gets an implicit bye (no auto-win). Intentional MC simplification vs real TI Swiss.
